paragraphs: Begin by receiving inbound mail and sorting it by department. In the morning, run outbound invoices through the postage meter, scan them, and generate labels. Clear jams as needed. Later, reconcile weekly postage bills, contact carriers for pickups, register exceptions, clean the mailroom, and prepare supplies for the next day.

In short, they ensure an organization's letters and packages go to the right places. They sort items, apply postage, enter shipments and generate labels, handle exceptions, reconcile accounts, and coordinate carriers, serving as internal logistics hubs.
